text:
lia: Heads up — assessor (RedTeamCo) asked for RBAC snapshots + KMS access window for evidence export. They want a 4h window next Tuesday (3/16). Can we confirm owner for the evidence bucket and who runs the ephemeral role?

omar: I can own the bucket and presigned URL flow. Need someone from infra for the ephemeral role and KMS policy review.

secbot: Ticket #SEC-4821 created for pen-test-intake. Assessor requested artifacts: access logs, KMS key policy, role snapshots, and presigned evidence link. ETA: 48h for initial handoff.

nina: @omar thanks — for KMS, keep the key in dev-key alias with rotate disabled during the window. We'll use a read-only crypto policy for the assessor. I'll draft the policy.

devops-eli: Re ephemeral roles: propose `assessor-access-temp` with duration 4h and session tags. We'll provision via `aws sts assume-role` and revoke at window end. Sample assume: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-access-temp --role-session-name redteam-session --duration-seconds 14400
```

samir: For audit logging, ensure CloudTrail multi-region enabled + S3 object-level logging for the evidence bucket. Also enable CloudWatch Insights retention for 90d for the test window. I'll add a Sigma-like query for suspicious activity sampling.

karen: Quick question on RBAC snapshot: do we want a full JSON export of all roles/policies or just the roles that can access the evidence bucket/KMS key? Assessors usually ask for both but smaller bundle speeds upload.

lia: assessor asked for full role snapshot + explicit role mappings for service accounts. But permit us to redact unrelated secrets. Keep uploads under `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/4823456789/` with `manifest.json` listing files.

omar: Agree on path. I'll create presigned put URLs and a short-lived manifest upload step. Command for presign: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/4823456789/evidence.tar.gz --expires-in 14400
```

secbot: Reminder: create ephemeral creds and upload confirmation message to thread once presigned URL generated.

nina: KMS policy draft (short): 
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Sid":"AllowAssessorEncryptDecrypt","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/assessor-access-temp"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"ForAnyValue:StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"s3.amazonaws.com"}}}
  ]
}
```

samir: Auditing note: flag any `AssumeRole` events in CloudTrail with `eventSource: "sts.amazonaws.com"` and `userAgent` containing `RedTeamCo`. Query snippet: 
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
| filter eventSource = "sts.amazonaws.com" and eventName = "AssumeRole"
| sort @timestamp desc
```

omar: I can schedule the 4h window 3/16 14:00-18:00 UTC. Can everyone confirm by EOD today? Need k8s serviceaccount map too — some logs come from pods.

karen: Confirmed for RBAC snapshot; I'll produce `roles-export-4823456789.json` with only role metadata (no secrets).

devops-eli: I'll add the IAM policy and create the `assessor-access-temp` role. Adding a step to revoke the role using `aws iam delete-role-policy` + role session invalidation post-window.

lia: Action list: 
- omar: create presigned URL and upload manifest (due EOD)
- nina: final KMS policy + approval (due EOD)
- devops-eli: create ephemeral role, post ARN (due EOD)
- samir: enable CloudTrail object-level logging and provide log query (done by EOD)
- karen: RBAC snapshot upload (by 3/15)

secbot: Action items recorded in SEC-4821. Next check-in at 17:00 UTC.

omar: One more — for retest coordination, can we reserve a fallback model: if anything fails, assessor gets read-only CSV export of findings rather than full presigned artifacts. Less sensitive and faster. Thoughts?

nina: Fine by me as fallback. We'll prefer full artifact handoff first.

lia: Perfect. I'll confirm the window and DM RedTeamCo with the SLO and contact points. Will post final confirmation here when done. :thumbsup:

secbot: SEC-4821 status -> in-progress.

lia: confirmed — all set. Closing this thread after final artifact upload.
